title: Deliver reviewed phenomenological external-source operator and frozen-epoch n/T response
body:
This change adds an illustrative, uncalibrated external-source operator on17thermal states plus2separate fast n/T reservoirs. It evaluates photon absorption, isotope/ion injection, two CR proton–He4 channels, finite slowing/escape, capture and beta daughters/energy bookkeeping at the same201saved ANGTHERM01 epochs and matching saved nHref. The deliverable is a frozen-epoch QSS/source-response diagnostic, not a time-evolution solution or calibrated cosmological abundance.

A fresh nonauthor review returned PASS_SCOPED after reading equations, implementation, raw outputs and the rendered figure. Seven test methods passed once; evaluation produced201rows/252columns. Maximum relative baryon/charge/effective-energy/QSS residuals are2.0141e-16/8.1764e-16/3.5570e-16/8.5260e-17. Alpha0/1/10 are sensitivity settings. One nonblocking metadata label was corrected from exact alignment to serialization alignment within absolute5e-15; original JSON and raw logs were preserved with no test/evaluation/plot rerun.

Phenomenological F4 source-model subobligation: COMPLETE_SCOPED. Historical physical F4 remains separate. Original working33/88, central28/88 and fast4/7 stay unchanged. Prior18-family nuclear history is not spliced into this baseline. Inverse-weak bath is NOT_INCLUDED_BY_MODEL. Physical calibration, transport justification and source/background timescale validation remain future work.

Each bounded phase completed once with no new IVP. Known cumulative charges including explicit remaining tail reserves are planning19.204540885 and presentation56.217331494 CPU seconds; original caps10/30 restored. Main595.225063/600 NO_MORE_IVPs unchanged; unmetered work remains UNKNOWN_NOT_ZERO.

Science commit acea5a7c8d951a956cf1c8173dd10eef28539f8a has7selected exact UTF8 readbacks and the matching PNG Git blob. Frozen recovery capsule REI_EXTERNAL_SOURCES_FINAL_20261028_69abffbdd128.json is1,348,887bytes, SHA25669abffbdd1281defac5b9840177cbb90b437aa4dbba4ddf5c6edecb53e8de3c8. Drive and Dropbox completed ACKs and separate metadata sizes match. Retrieved article bodies are excluded from both publication and backup. Final additive DELIVERY_RECEIPT.json records exact provider/publication identities outside the frozen capsule.
